description: Implementation of Local Bank Funded Etampitiya Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-11-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply,  for the implementation of Etampitiya Water Supply Project at a cost of Rs.2,039 million secured from the local banks, with a Treasury Guarantee,  was approved by the Cabinet.
